decisions.reason: The construction site dumper builds on the firm's vehicle and dump-hauling engineering know-how, so it can learn from early results, although the related underground dump trucks were already dropped and the product was only mentioned rather than featured.
The inclined furniture lift sits within the firm's stated lifting and material-handling expertise and had its own page, so the firm can interpret results and improve the product.
The inclined building material lift combines the firm's lifting know-how with its construction customer base, giving strong related knowledge to absorb market feedback.
The truck-mounted variant extends the same inclined-lift platform with the firm's vehicle experience, so it stays close to existing knowledge despite slightly higher complexity.
